080        protected void giveColossus(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
081                ShipVariantAPI v = Global.getSettings().getVariant("colossus_Standard").clone();
082                FleetMemberAPI member = Global.getFactory().createFleetMember(FleetMemberType.SHIP, v);
083                Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getFleetData().addFleetMember(member);
084                AddShip.addShipGainText(member, dialog.getTextPanel());
085                
086        }
087
088        protected void givePhaeton(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
089                //System.out.print("givePhaeton called");
090                ShipVariantAPI v = Global.getSettings().getVariant("phaeton_Standard").clone();
091                FleetMemberAPI member = Global.getFactory().createFleetMember(FleetMemberType.SHIP, v);
092                Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getFleetData().addFleetMember(member);
093                AddShip.addShipGainText(member, dialog.getTextPanel());
094        }
095
096        protected boolean isArroyoContact() {
097                PersonAPI person = People.getPerson(ARROYO); 
098                boolean isContact = ContactIntel.playerHasContact(person, true);
099                //System.out.print("isArroyoContact? result: " +isContact );
100                return isContact; 
101        }
